# AI slop remover

## My own clich√©s to catch

- Sparkle icons on everything
- Random blobs in the background

## Common AI clich√©s

Looks:

- Literal theme decoration: drawing the subject instead of designing for it (brick patterns for a place called the Brickyard, a sun for a lake, tape and paper for a flyer)
- Tilted, taped or "sticker" cards
- Condensed all-caps poster type used for everything to look "bold"
- Purple or blue-to-purple gradients, gradient text
- Glowing, glassy or neon effects used as decoration
- The same big rounded corners and soft shadow on everything
- Emoji used as icons
- A generic font picked for no reason
Layout:
- Body text so big that only one post fits on a phone screen
- Floating buttons that cover content
- Rows of identical cards with an icon on top
- Cards inside cards
- A big header with three large statistics
- Everything centered
- A small label in capitals above every heading
- Numbering (01, 02, 03) on things that aren't steps
Motion:
- Everything fading in as you scroll; things lifting on hover when you can't click them
Words:
- A generic heart standing in for the app's own reaction (if the app has its own word for a like, give it its own symbol or label)
- Filler labels like "Busiest spots" or "Trending now" that say nothing
- "Seamless", "elevate", "unlock", "effortless"
- Three-word slogans like "Fast. Simple. Beautiful."
- Labels that repeat what's already obvious
- Made-up numbers or testimonials

## While creating

Check your own work against the list below before you show it to me. Fix anything you find first, then tell me in one line what you removed.

## When reviewing

1. Check every screen and list each clich√© with where it is.
2. Three or more on one screen means that screen fails.
3. Fix in this order: remove it, tone it down, replace it with something from the design system.
4. Choose replacements that fit the project's own design direction.
5. Show me before and after. Don't change how features work.

## Rule

If the design direction asks for one of these on purpose, keep it.
